answer: With a Weekly community check-in streak over four seasons verified by signed timestamps, trust accrues only through repeated presence: every week the applicant signs in, the signed timestamps go on the public record, and one missed week resets the streak to zero, so a fake identity that lapses even once loses its standing and must start over. One cipher proves nothing on its own; the proof is in the unbroken run. A plume and a fable may look alike, but only the identity with an unbroken record is honoured.
